_comment: Copy to floors.private.json (gitignored) and run npm run build. Floors are solved in order; append a new floor each day. Up to 8 answers per floor; they are normalized at build time (tashkeel, أ/إ/آ, ة, ى, digits, leading ال). Optional "hint" is shown under the question. Optional "opens" (YYYY-MM-DD) schedules a floor for 06:00 Asia/Hebron that day; undated floors come first. "publicWords" lists answers that may appear in public files on purpose (the game name, town names), so the leak check skips them.

floors.q: سؤال يُفتح يوم 1 تشرين الثاني الساعة 6:00 بتوقيت فلسطين
